title: 第562章 吴慧妈妈失踪了第561章 神秘水蜜桃
content_zh:
吴慧把两层楼找了一遍，也没见到妈妈的身影。
吴慧焦急地喊着，“妈妈，你在家里？”
她哭了，“妈妈，你千万不要出事啊！”
“这个世界上，我就剩下你一个亲人，你要是出事了，我可怎么办啊！”
叶开神识外放，在周围两公里内搜寻着。
他发现陆文清就在邻居岛田太太家，被绑在椅子上，嘴里塞着毛巾。
叶开拍了拍吴慧肩膀，“别哭了，我发现你妈妈了。”
“在哪里？”
“跟我来。”
两人从家里出来，绕到岛田太太家院子后边，叶开抱着吴慧跳进院子里，来到岛田太太家后门，发功打开了铁门。
两人悄悄地走进去，看见陆文清被绑在一把椅子上，旁边的沙发上坐着一男一女。
女的就是岛田太太，男的是她老公岛田树。
岛田树非常敏锐，听见了动静，转身一看，看见了叶开二人，
“你们两个好大的胆子，竟敢闯进我家，真是天堂有路你不走，地狱无门你偏进来！”
岛田树站起来，向叶开扑过来。
岛田太太则向陆文清冲去，要挟持陆文清当作人质。
这两人分工明确，配合默契，看来平时训练有素。
叶开使出一阳指，两道白光分别向岛田树和岛田太太射去！
岛田太太大叫一声，捂着喉咙倒在地上，血汩汩的流出来。
岛田树出掌，掌风霍霍，挡住了叶开这一指，倒是出乎叶开的预料。

“咦，有点能耐！再接我一招。”
叶开五指连弹，五道白光分别向岛田树的咽喉心口，腹部和双腿射去，
岛田树顾头顾不了腚，防住了咽喉心口和腹部要害部位，双腿中招，咔咔两声，腿骨断了。
岛田树扑通跪在地上，仍然狠狠地一掌向叶开打来。
叶开出掌和岛田树对拼，嘭的一声响，岛田树飞起来，撞在墙上，把墙撞了一个洞，又掉在地上，晕死过去。
吴慧跑到陆文清身边，解去她身上的绳子，把嘴里的毛巾掏出来，母女二人抱在一起。
劫后重生，她们喜极而泣，抱头痛哭。
叶开取来一碗水泼在岛田树脸上，把他弄醒。
叶开喝问，“说，谁派你来的？”
岛田树倔强地紧咬嘴唇，一言不发。
“哼，我叫你不说话！”
叶开点了岛田树几处穴位岛田树如万箭穿心，疼的在地上打滚。
再加上断腿的疼痛，他实在受不了这种巨大的痛苦，
“我说，我说！”
叶开点了他的麻穴，缓解了他的疼痛，“说吧，谁派你来的？”
“涩谷川派我来的。”
叶开听说过涩谷川这个名字，是田园和杨影这两个东瀛女人说的，涩谷川是东瀛有名的药王，擅长造各种毒药。
“涩谷川在哪里？”
“我不知道。”
“八嘎，你还不老实！”叶开扬起手，准备重重地拍下去。

岛田树吓得魂飞魄散，赶紧求饶，
“不要打我，我没见过涩谷川，但是我知道他在哪里。”
content_en:
Wu Hui searched the two floors but could not find her mother.
Wu Hui shouted anxiously, "Mom, are you at home?"
She cried, "Mom, please don't let anything happen to you!"
"You are the only relative I have left in this world. If something happens to you, what will I do?"
Ye Kai released his consciousness and searched within two kilometers of the surrounding area.
He found Lu Wenqing at his neighbor's Mrs. Shimada's house, tied to a chair with a towel stuffed in his mouth.
Ye Kai patted Wu Hui on the shoulder, "Stop crying, I found your mother."
"Where?"
"Follow me."
The two came out of the house and went around to the back of Mrs. Shimada's yard. Ye Kai jumped into the yard with Wu Hui in his arms, came to the back door of Mrs. Shimada's house, and used his strength to open the iron gate.
The two walked in quietly and saw Lu Wenqing tied to a chair, with a man and a woman sitting on the sofa next to him.
The woman is Mrs. Shimada, and the man is her husband, Itsuki Shimada.
Shimada Shu was very keen and heard the movement. He turned around and saw Ye Kai and the others.
"You two are so brave, you dare to break into my house. It's true that there is a way to heaven but you didn't take it, and there is no way to hell and you just walked in!"
Shimada Shu stood up and rushed towards Ye Kai.
Mrs. Shimada rushed towards Lu Wenqing and threatened to take Lu Wenqing as a hostage.
The two men have a clear division of labor and a tacit understanding of cooperation. They seem to be well-trained.
Ye Kai used his Yang Finger and shot two white lights at Shimada Shu and Mrs. Shimada respectively!
Mrs. Shimada yelled, clutching her throat and fell to the ground, blood pouring out.
Shimada took out his palm, and the palm wind was strong, blocking Ye Kai's finger, which was beyond Ye Kai's expectation.
"Hey, you're quite capable! Take another move from me."
Ye Kai flicked his five fingers, and five white lights shot towards Shimada Shu's throat, abdomen and legs respectively.
Shimada looked away from his head and body, and guarded his throat, heart, and vital parts of his abdomen. His legs were hit with two clicks, and his leg bones were broken.
Shimada Shu fell to his knees on the ground and still hit Ye Kai with a fierce palm.
Ye Kai used his palm to fight Shimada Shu. With a bang, Shimada Shu flew up and hit the wall, making a hole in the wall. He fell to the ground again and fainted.
Wu Hui ran to Lu Wenqing, untied the rope from her body, took out the towel from her mouth, and the mother and daughter hugged each other.
After being reborn after the disaster, they cried with joy and cried in each other's arms.
Ye Kai took a bowl of water and poured it on Shimada Shu's face to wake him up.
Ye Kai shouted and asked, "Tell me, who sent you here?"
Shimada Shu bit his lip stubbornly and said nothing.
"Huh, I told you not to speak!"
Ye Kai clicked on several acupuncture points of the Shimada tree, and the Shimada tree rolled on the ground in pain like a thousand arrows piercing his heart.
Coupled with the pain of his broken leg, he really couldn't bear the tremendous pain.
"I said, I said!"
Ye Kai clicked on his numb point to relieve his pain, "Tell me, who sent you here?"
"Shibuya River sent me."
Ye Kai had heard of the name Shibuya River from two Japanese women, Tian Yuan and Yang Ying. Shibuya River was a famous medicine king in Japan and was good at making various poisons.
"Where is the Shibuya River?"
"I don't know."
"Baga, you are not honest!" Ye Kai raised his hand, preparing to slap it down hard.
Shimada Shu was so frightened that he quickly begged for mercy.
"Don't hit me, I haven't seen Shibuya River, but I know where he is."
